This synthetic workspace CSV follows [Linear's documented workspace issue export](https://linear.app/docs/exporting-data). It contains three issues in two teams, no priority/high/low values, assigned and unassigned issues, a label/project/cycle, supplied timestamps and due date, a parent reference, an archived source value, quoted Unicode/newline descriptions, and unsupported Creator/SLA columns. It contains no real account data, comments or attachment bytes. Native references are created through Vector's normal administration routes by the test. Archived values and unsupported columns must be reported and retained in the exact original; they must not silently change native lifecycle or grant membership.
